original: ペースの速い日本語の会話は、まだ理解出来ません。

en.text: I still can’t understand fast-paced Japanese dialogue yet.

original: なぜトムはそれが出来ないんだろう。

en.text: I wonder why Tom can't do that.

original: あなたにそれが出来ると思う？

en.text: Do you think that you could do that?
Do you think you could do that?
Do you think you can do that?

original: トムはそれが出来なかった理由を説明した。

en.text: Tom explained why he wasn't able to do that.

original: 君にこれが出来るとは思わない。

en.text: I don't think that you can do this.
I don't think you can do this.

original: トムはそれが出来たが、メアリーは出来なかった。

en.text: Tom was able to do that, but Mary wasn't.

original: 開店前なのにラーメン屋の前では列が出来ていた。

en.text: People lined up in front of the ramen restaurant although it was not open yet.

original: 出来たてがうまいと言われても、熱くて食べられない。

en.text: People say it's delicious hot out of the pan, but I can't eat it when it's that hot.

original: どうやったらそんなに遅く出来るんだよ！

en.text: How could you be so late!
